'''Saucer Droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used in the detention levels of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The dome-shaped droids moved back and forth across the floor and featured red and green lights. A small sensor could be seen on the top as they moved. When the droids stopped a top hatch opened to allow more sensors and lights to raise up.<ref name="SSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
These droids are enemies in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] game ''[[Super Star Wars]]'', where players first encounter them on the detention level when searching for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]]. ''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' first named the droids.<ref name="Secrets">''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]''</ref>
